text: Gita Saxena is a Full-Stack Developer Consultant at NexGen Solutions, specializing in cloud infrastructure and application development. With a focus on scalable solutions, she leverages AWS to design resilient systems, often managing EC2 instances and S3 storage for client projects. Her expertise in Docker streamlines deployment processes, while GitLab CI automates testing pipelines, ensuring consistent delivery. JavaScript and Node.js underpin her work on dynamic web applications, often integrated with REST APIs to connect backend services. PostgreSQL serves as the backbone for data-driven platforms she architects, balancing performance and security. React powers intuitive user interfaces, reflecting her commitment to seamless user experiences. Beyond technical skills, Gita thrives in collaborative environments, translating business needs into robust, maintainable code. Her approach blends strategic thinking with hands-on execution, making her a reliable partner for complex tech challenges. With a knack for simplifying complexity, she empowers teams to innovate efficiently in fast-paced consulting projects.
